question: Using a Western (NCHS) growth chart instead of the WHO 2006 or IAP 2015 growth chart is an acceptable alternative for routine nutritional assessment of Indian children under 5 years.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is false. The WHO 2006 standards apply to children 0–5 years and the IAP 2015 charts for children over 5 years in India. Using an inappropriate reference leads to systematic misclassification.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this statement is false. Using an inappropriate reference chart (such as NCHS instead of WHO 2006 for under-5s, or WHO instead of IAP 2015 for older children) is the single most common error in growth chart interpretation in Indian practice.
